attrs.evidence: Membership witnesses are ONE-SIDED and the round-3 research pass claimed more for them than they carry. One satisfying assignment per admitted value proves M ⊆ true projection; nothing proves true projection ⊆ M. A site that under-reports its projection passes every membership check — demonstrated executably — and an omitted feasible value can manufacture a false empty message and hence a false UNSAT. Three distinct objects need distinguishing: a positive SAT certificate (constructive witnesses composing to a global assignment), an exact decision message (needs the exact projection), and a negative/UNSAT certificate (needs proof that excluded values are impossible, or an independently checkable local proof system). Directly relevant to TRVM/WRL-style continuous proof.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6 round-3 audit posed it; the round-4 audit found the direct neighbourhood. ATSERIAS, KOLAITIS & VARDI, "Constraint Propagation as a Proof System", CP 2004 (DOI 10.1007/978-3-540-30201-8_9) gives a sound-and-complete CSP refutation system over axioms, relational joins, projections and weakening, terminating in the empty relation — which is unusually close to what this claim asks for. Two routes follow. (a) TWO-SIDED BY CASES: for each v ∈ M a satisfying subtree assignment with x = v; for each v ∉ M a checkable refutation of subtree ∧ (x = v). Together those give M ⊆ truth AND truth ⊆ M. (b) NATIVE: a join/project derivation whose final derived unary relation IS M, so the verifier checks the relational proof rather than trusting a solver — this mirrors the separator algorithm itself instead of hiding it behind SAT, which is why it is the interesting one for TRVM/WRL. Alternatives to compare: SAT encoding with LRAT/DRAT refutations; pseudo-Boolean with VeriPB-style checking; OBDD representations, which Atserias–Kolaitis–Vardi also discuss.
attrs.review_focus: This is the gap between "the protocol is exact" and "the protocol is trustless", and cell 36b cannot be called proof-carrying until it closes. The comparison to make is certificate size, checker complexity, incremental reuse and compositionality.
attrs.statement: What proof object establishes BOTH inclusion and exclusion for a separator projection, so that a receiving site need not trust the sending site's solver?
